summary.allegation: The cardholder says they never received the goods from LumaTech Electronics and that the address on the order is not theirs and was not authorised by them for delivery.
summary.to_defend: Visa requires proof the goods were delivered on or before the chargeback date to an address that materially matches the address the cardholder gave at purchase.

requirements.title: Proof of delivery
requirements.text: Proof of delivery: tracking number, carrier name, and confirmation of delivery to the cardholder's address.
requirements.finding: The DPDx screenshot gives a tracking number, the carrier name and a DELIVERED status on 10 April 2025 for a parcel sent by LumaTech Electronics, but the parcel was left in a safe place with no signature or photo and the recipient is shown only as the generic 'Lumatech Customer', so delivery to the cardholder personally is not evidenced.
requirements.gap: No signature, proof-of-delivery photo, geotag or named recipient tying the parcel to the cardholder, and the delivery address is not the cardholder's billing address.

citations.quote:
Tracking number: 15441288821100
Status: DELIVERED
Delivered: 10 April 2025, 15:22

requirements.title: Service rendered
requirements.text: For services: evidence the service was rendered on or before the expected date (booking confirmation, attendance log, access logs).
requirements.finding: This is a sale of physical goods (headphones and an iPad) by an electronics retailer, MCC 5732, shipped by carrier, so there is no service to evidence as rendered.

requirements.title: Delivered before chargeback date
requirements.text: Date of delivery / service rendered is on or before the chargeback date.
requirements.finding: The carrier record shows delivery on 10 April 2025, the day after the 9 April 2025 transaction and well before the 2 May 2025 chargeback date.

requirements.title: Delivery address matches
requirements.text: The delivery address materially matches the address provided by the cardholder at purchase.
requirements.finding: The delivery address (Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, Manchester M1 7DR) matches the shipping address on order LT-200931, but it does not match the cardholder's billing postcode M14 5RT, AVS returned N and the cardholder denies the address is theirs, so it is not established that this is an address the cardholder provided.
requirements.gap: No independent link between the cardholder and the M1 7DR address, such as prior undisputed orders shipped there, account records or customer contact confirming the address.

alerts.text: The cardholder states the delivery address is not theirs; AVS returned N and the shipping postcode M1 7DR differs from the billing postcode M14 5RT, and nothing in D1 or D2 independently links the cardholder to that address. Confirm whether the merchant holds prior order or account history for that address.

The DPDx record names the recipient only as 'Lumatech Customer' rather than the customer 'A. Carter' shown on order LT-200931, and the parcel was left unattended in a safe place; check whether the carrier can supply the named recipient or a proof-of-delivery image.
Evidence for R1, R3 was read from an image. Check the highlight.

reasons: Key evidence read from an image
Evidence conflicts with the claim or the transaction data

checks.label: Key evidence comes from document text, not only from an image
Images the evidence relies on are fully legible
Every quoted passage was found in the documents
The disputed charge matches the merchant's own records
The rule check and the AI recommendation agree

justification: R4 is only partial because the delivery address does not match the cardholder's billing address and AVS failed, and R1 lacks any named-recipient proof, both of which the merchant may be able to close with account and carrier records.
rationale: Order LT-200931 dated 9 April 2025 for GBP 642.00 matches the disputed transaction txn_9931CD in amount, currency and date.
merchant_requests: Carrier proof of delivery from DPDx for tracking 15441288821100 showing signature, GPS coordinates or a doorstep photo for the 10 April 2025 delivery.
Account history for the customer a.carter****@gmail.com showing prior undisputed orders shipped to Flat 14, 7 Aspen Wharf, Manchester M1 7DR.
Login, IP and device records for the account used on order LT-200931 compared with IP 188.29.44.179 and device fp_c01e84f2b9 on earlier undisputed orders.
Any post-delivery contact with the customer about order LT-200931, such as emails, support tickets, warranty registration or returns requests.
Checkout record showing the billing address entered at purchase and why AVS returned N for postcode M14 5RT.
analyst_notes: Confirm with the merchant that only one charge of GBP 642.00 was taken on card ending 8821 for order LT-200931.
3DS shows 'attempted' only, so no liability shift; weigh this before committing to representment.
